pages.text: While sitting on a stool, your body stays $(bold)locked to the stool's facing$() — the same logic as riding a vanilla boat/horse.$(br2)Turning your head is clamped to $(bold)90° left or right of the stool's facing$() (180° total) — no spinning in circles.
Turning feels identical to vanilla riding — smooth, no mouse fighting.$(br2)$(bold)Getting up$(): press Shift (sneak) to stand up, just like dismounting.
